title: Recording: Some Time In New York City demos by John Lennon | 1971
content:
John Lennon recorded demos of a number of new songs on 26 December 1971.

The songs would mostly end up on his 1972 album with Yoko Ono, Some Time In New York City.

At their rented apartment at 105 Bank Street, Manhattan, Lennon taped the songs using a portable cassette recorder: ‘Woman Is The N****r Of The World’, ‘Call My Name’, ‘Say It Again’, ‘Shoeshine’, ‘New York City’, ‘People’, ‘Send Me Some Lovin”, ‘He Got The Blues’, ‘Man Is Half Of Woman (Woman Is Half Of Man)’, ‘Pill’, ‘It’s Real’, ‘I Ain’t Got Time’, ‘Mr Moonlight’, and ‘She’ll Be Coming Round The Mountain’.

Page last updated: 10 August 2026
